prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object is approached, take it and move to destination, check weight and do task. If not visible, approach object or scan area.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Condition ID = IsDestinationReached    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectWeight    /> <Action ID = DoTask    /> <Sequence ID = ApproachObject>     <Action ID = NavigateToObject    />     <Condition ID = IsObjectInReach    /> </Sequence> <Sequence ID = ScanArea>     <Action ID = NavigateToScanPoint    />     <Condition ID = IsObjectFound    /> </Sequence>"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToDestination
			IF IsDestinationReached? THEN
			DO CheckObjectWeight
	ELSE
		DO DoTask
	END
